description: Take-home pay (New Zealand) [NZ]. Works out yearly take-home pay for one main NZ job: income tax, ACC earners' levy, KiwiSaver, student loan and the independent earner tax credit, plus effective and marginal rates and the likely tax code. Divide by 52, 26 or 12 for per-pay figures. Doesn't handle secondary jobs, tailored tax codes, non-residents or the temporary 3% KiwiSaver rate.

annualGross.description: Gross annual salary or wages before tax, from one main job

claimIetc.description: Claim the independent earner tax credit through the ME code, if eligible

kiwisaverRate.description: Employee KiwiSaver rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.035; 0 if not in KiwiSaver

name: nz_take_home
